RUS_ip_enable_gui = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = RUS
			is_ai = no
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_ui_unlocked }
		}
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_ui_unlocked
		RUS_ip_open_effect = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_open_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
		}
		RUS_ip_initialize = yes
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_cancel_armed
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_close_effect = {
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
	clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_cancel_armed
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_dirty = 1 }
}

RUS_ip_toggle = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			}
			RUS_ip_close_effect = yes
		}
		else = {
			RUS_ip_open_effect = yes
		}
	}
}

RUS_ip_start = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_available = yes
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_open
			NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_ip_started }
		}
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_started
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_days_left = 1800 }
		RUS_ip_refresh_extraction = yes
		RUS_ip_capture_capacity = yes
		RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	}
}

RUS_ip_toggle_help = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
		}
		clr_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = RUS_ip_help_open
	}
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_dirty = 1 }
}

RUS_ip_refresh_extraction = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_started
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_mining_completed < 15 }
			}
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty = RUS_ip_mining_completed }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty = 0.02 }
			subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty = 0.3 }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_resource_penalty min = -0.3 max = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_extraction_bottleneck } }
				}
				add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_extraction_bottleneck }
			}
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_extraction_bottleneck }
				}
				remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_extraction_bottleneck }
			}
		}
	}
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty_percent = RUS_ip_resource_penalty }
	multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_resource_penalty_percent = 100 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

RUS_ip_capture_capacity = {
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_civs = num_of_civilian_factories_available_for_projects }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_civs = RUS_ip_reserved_civs }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_capacity_civs min = 0 max = 99999 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_steel = resource@steel }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_steel = RUS_ip_reserved_steel }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_capacity_steel min = 0 max = 99999 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_coal = resource@coal }
	add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_capacity_coal = RUS_ip_reserved_coal }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_capacity_coal min = 0 max = 99999 }
}

RUS_ip_survey = {
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_connected_count = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_energy = energy_ratio }
	clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_energy min = 0 max = 1 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_energy_percent = RUS_ip_energy }

RUS_ip_allocate = {
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_queued = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_running = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs = RUS_ip_capacity_civs }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_civs = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_free_steel = RUS_ip_capacity_steel }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_steel = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_free_coal = RUS_ip_capacity_coal }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_coal = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_running = 0 }
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_status = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_project > 0 }
		}
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_queued = 1 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_status = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_project = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
					RUS_ip_site_0_1 = yes
					check_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_paused = 0 }
				}
				set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_status = 5 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs < 2 }
						}
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { RUS_ip_free_steel < 2 }
						}
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { RUS_ip_free_coal < 0 }
						}
					}
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_running = 1 }
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_status = 1 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_running = 1 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs = 2 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_civs = 2 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_steel = 2 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_steel = 2 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_coal = 0 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_coal = 0 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_project = 2 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
					RUS_ip_site_0_2 = yes
					check_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_paused = 0 }
				}
				set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_status = 5 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs < 2 }
						}
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { RUS_ip_free_steel < 2 }
						}
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { RUS_ip_free_coal < 1 }
						}
					}
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_running = 1 }
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_status = 1 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_running = 1 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs = 2 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_civs = 2 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_steel = 2 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_steel = 2 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_coal = 1 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_coal = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_project = 3 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
					RUS_ip_site_0_3 = yes
					check_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_paused = 0 }
				}
				set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_status = 5 }
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs < 3 }
						}
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { RUS_ip_free_steel < 4 }
						}
						NOT = {
							check_variable = { RUS_ip_free_coal < 2 }
						}
					}
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_running = 1 }
					set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_status = 1 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_running = 1 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_civs = 3 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_civs = 3 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_steel = 4 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_steel = 4 }
					subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_free_coal = 2 }
					add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_reserved_coal = 2 }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_project = 4 }

RUS_ip_apply_reservations = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_running > 0 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_construction_commitment } }
			}
			add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_construction_commitment }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_construction_commitment }
			}
			remove_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_ip_construction_commitment }
		}
	}
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
}

			}
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = RUS_ip_n35_steel }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_speed_part min = 0 max = 40 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 0.005 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = RUS_ip_n35_freight }
			divide_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 1 }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_speed_part min = 0.1 max = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_project = 3 }
			}
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = RUS_ip_n35_coal }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_speed_part min = 0 max = 40 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 0.005 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }

			divide_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 1 }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_speed_part min = 0.1 max = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_project = 4 }
			}
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = RUS_ip_n35_steel }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_speed_part min = 0 max = 40 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 0.005 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = RUS_ip_n35_freight }
			divide_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 2 }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_speed_part min = 0.1 max = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = RUS_ip_energy }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 0.75 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 0.25 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_project = 5 }
			}
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = RUS_ip_n35_steel }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_speed_part min = 0 max = 40 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 0.005 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = RUS_ip_n35_freight }
			divide_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 3 }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_speed_part min = 0.1 max = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = RUS_ip_energy }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 0.75 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 0.25 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_project = 6 }
			}
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = RUS_ip_n35_steel }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_speed_part min = 0 max = 40 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 0.005 }
			add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }
			set_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = RUS_ip_n35_freight }
			divide_variable = { RUS_ip_speed_part = 1 }
			clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_speed_part min = 0.1 max = 1 }
			multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_speed = RUS_ip_speed_part }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_eta = RUS_ip_n35_required }
		subtract_from_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_eta = RUS_ip_n35_work }
		divide_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_eta = RUS_ip_n35_speed }
	}
	set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_percent = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_required > 0 }
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_percent = RUS_ip_n35_work }
		divide_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_percent = RUS_ip_n35_required }
		multiply_variable = { RUS_ip_n35_percent = 100 }
		clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_n35_percent min = 0 max = 100 }
	}
}

RUS_ip_complete_0_1 = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_country_flag = RUS_ip_active
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_project = 1 }
			check_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_running = 1 }
			NOT = {
				check_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_work < RUS_ip_n0_required }
			}
			RUS_ip_site_0_1 = yes
		}
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_project = 0 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_running = 0 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_work = 0 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_required = 0 }
		set_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_last_kind = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_completed = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_n0_mine_1 = 1 }
		add_to_variable = { RUS_ip_mining_completed = 1 }
		clamp_variable = { var = RUS_ip_mining_completed min = 0 max = 15 }
		213 = {
			add_resource = { type = coal amount = 4 }
		}
	}
}

RUS_ip_build_1 = {
	RUS_ip_refresh = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			RUS_ip_can_build_1 = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
